title: The Bhagavad Gita
description: Based on HH Sri Raghavendra Teertha's Gita Vivruti

verses.sanskrit:
धर्मक्षेत्रे कुरुक्षेत्रे समवेता युयुत्सवः |
मामकाः पाण्डवाश्चैव किमकुर्वत सञ्जय ||
verses.transliteration:
dharmakshetra kurukshetra samaveta yuyutsavah |
mamakah pandavash chaiva kimakurvata sanjaya ||
verses.translation: Dhrutarashtra said: O Sanjaya! Assembled at Kuru Kshetra, the designated land for committing righteous acts (Field of Righteousness), what did my clan of Kauravas and Pandavas do?

verses.sanskrit:
दृष्ट्वा तु पाण्डवानीकं व्यूढं दुर्योधनस्तदा |
आचार्यमुपसंगम्य राजा वचनमब्रवीत् ||
verses.transliteration:
drishtvaa tu paandavaaneekam vyudham duryodhanastaada |
aacharyamupasanganmya raajaa vachanamabraveet ||
verses.translation: Sanjaya said: King Duryodhana, upon seeing the formation of the Pandavas' army, immediately rushed to his teacher Drona, and said as follows.

verses.sanskrit:
पश्यैतां पाण्डुपुत्राणामाचार्य महतीं चमूम् |
व्यूढां द्रुपदपुत्रेण तव शिष्येण धीमता ||
verses.transliteration:
pashyaitaam paanduputraanaamaachaarya mahateem chamoom |
vyudhaam drupadaputrena tava shishyena dheemat ||
verses.translation: O My Teacher! Look at the formation of the mighty army of Pandavas which has been organized by your clever student Dhrushtadyumna, son of Drupada.
